newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Seal holders seek to oust directors.
newsitem.headline: Seal holders seek to oust directors.

text.p: Two substantial shareholders of Seal Inc have requested an extraordinary general meeting on October 1 to remove four company directors.

A circular from the timber and properties group to shareholders dated September 16 said that the directors targeted for removal are Seal chairman Jaffar Abdul, deputy chairman Soo Thian Chai, and directors Chai Seen and Lim Chew Yin.
The two substantial shareholders are Aik Shing Development Sdn Bhd, which owns 35.9 percent of Seal, and Richlane Corp Sdn Bhd, which owns 14.89 percent, the circular said.
Seal officials could not be reached for further comment on Wednesday. The circular said Seal's directors had agreed to convene the meeting to consider the proposals.
Letters dated August 26 from Aik Shing and Richlane to Seal did not state a reason for the proposals.

In an interview with a local newspaper in June, Lee Aik Chong, executive director of Aik Shing and Richlane, said he planned to move Seal into property development and construction as well as palm oil plantations to restore Seal's profits.
